purpose: Execution queue for the user-supplied model exchange mandate, not a capability claim.

requirements.title: Objective
requirements.requirement:
Expand external modelling-tool interoperability from simple file storage into a complete governed model exchange subsystem.

The openEHR Modelling Assistant must support a workflow in which:

Archetype Designer / Modelling Tool
              ↓
         Model Export
              ↓
openEHR Modelling Assistant
              ↓
      Identify Artefact Type
              ↓
      Preserve Original
              ↓
     Validate / Inspect
              ↓
       Semantic Analysis
              ↓
        Repository
              ↓
    Review / Governance
              ↓
      Build / Compile
              ↓
       Reviewed Handoff
              ↓
Archetype Designer / Modelling Tool

Do not reduce integration to:

upload file
→
store file
→
download file

The modelling assistant must understand the role and provenance of each artefact while preserving the exact source representation.

requirements.title: Preserve Original Source Artefacts
requirements.requirement:
Every imported artefact must be stored exactly as received.

Never silently:

reformat
rename
normalise
convert
rewrite
pretty-print
change encoding
change identifiers
remove metadata

in the immutable original source artefact.

Record:

content hash
filename
media type
artefact type
source system
source version
source revision
retrieval/import timestamp
importing user
repository revision

Derived representations must be stored separately.
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

requirements.title: Artefact Type System
requirements.requirement:
Introduce explicit model artefact types.

At minimum distinguish:

ADL_ARCHETYPE
OET_TEMPLATE
OPT
WEB_TEMPLATE
DESIGNER_AUTHORING_JSON
CANONICAL_COMPOSITION
FLAT_COMPOSITION
STRUCTURED_COMPOSITION
TERMINOLOGY_ARTEFACT
MODEL_PACKAGE
OTHER

Do not infer artefact semantics merely from filename extension.

Where detection is uncertain, classify explicitly as:

UNKNOWN

and require inspection.

requirements.title: Archetype Designer Authoring JSON
requirements.requirement:
Treat Archetype Designer authoring files such as:

*.t.json

as:

DESIGNER_AUTHORING_JSON

They are not automatically:

OET
OPT
Web Template
canonical openEHR interchange format

Never rename:

something.t.json

to:

something.opt

or otherwise imply semantic equivalence.

requirements.title: Source vs Derived Artefacts
requirements.requirement:
Maintain explicit relationships:

Designer Authoring Artefact
          │
          ├── original source
          │
          └── exported openEHR artefact
                    │
                    ├── OET
                    │
                    └── OPT

where such exports actually exist.

Store relationships explicitly:

SOURCE_OF
EXPORTED_AS
COMPILED_FROM
DERIVED_FROM
REVISION_OF

Never infer that two files are equivalent merely because they share a name.

requirements.title: Provenance Model
Import Pipeline
requirements.requirement:
Implement:

Receive artefact
      ↓
Security validation
      ↓
Detect/declare artefact type
      ↓
Hash original
      ↓
Store immutable original
      ↓
Extract metadata
      ↓
Parse where supported
      ↓
Validate where supported
      ↓
Build semantic representation
      ↓
Determine dependencies
      ↓
Record provenance
      ↓
Create repository revision

Failure to parse must not destroy the original artefact.

requirements.title: Model Import API
requirements.requirement:

model_artifact_get
model_artifact_list
model_artifact_history
model_artifact_compare
model_artifact_export

requirements.title: Optimistic Concurrency
requirements.requirement:
Continue using:

expectedRevision

for model updates.

Workflow:

read revision 42
      ↓
edit
      ↓
save expectedRevision=42

If repository state is now:

revision 43

reject the stale write.

Return a structured conflict.

Never silently overwrite newer modelling work.
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

requirements.title: Conflict Response
requirements.requirement:
A revision conflict should expose sufficient information to reconcile.

For example:

{
  "error": "REVISION_CONFLICT",
  "expectedRevision": "42",
  "currentRevision": "43",
  "artifact": "...",
  "resolution": "retrieve-current-and-reconcile"
}

Where possible provide access to semantic diff.
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

requirements.title: Real openEHR Validation
requirements.requirement:

The platform should distinguish:

XML well-formedness
schema/structural checks
ADL parsing
ADL validation
AOM validation
OET validation
OPT validation
RM validation
terminology validation
composition validation

Never collapse these into one generic:

VALID

result.
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

 +

dependency resolution

openEHR validation

template compilation

OPT

OPT validation

source OET revision

compiler
compiler version

validation result

requirements.note: Implemented native ADL 2 and bounded legacy OET compilation profiles with exact-revision build evidence. Full OET/AOM semantics, external tool interchange and the complete exchange governance contract remain open.

from:

Compile same governed source

OPT B
OPT A
   ↓
semantic comparison
   ↑
OPT B

Compare model semantics.

node identifiers

cardinalities

units

automation availability

requirements.requirement:
Do not assume hosted Archetype Designer capabilities.

Where APIs or automation are available, determine capabilities from:

documented API
authenticated capability check
verified account behaviour

Do not infer features from UI appearance or historical documentation alone.

Manual Exchange Mode

   ↓
Manual export

Assistant import

Modelling / validation / governance

authenticated Designer adapter
   ↓
retrieve/push artefact

Do not place Designer-specific API code in the modelling domain.

requirements.requirement:
Create:

with capabilities such as:

capabilities
list artefacts
retrieve artefact
import artefact
export artefact
retrieve revision
compare revision

Then implement:

ArchetypeDesignerAdapter

where technically supported.

requirements.requirement:
If sufficient stable knowledge exists to inspect .t.json, implement a dedicated adapter.

However:

DESIGNER_AUTHORING_JSON

must remain its own source format.

Any transformation to openEHR-standard artefacts must be:

explicit
version-aware
tested
traceable

Never advertise undocumented reverse engineering as guaranteed interoperability.

requirements.title: Preserve Unknown Fields

save

+

SECTION
OBSERVATION
EVALUATION
INSTRUCTION
ACTION
ADMIN_ENTRY
CLUSTER

slots
occurrences
cardinalities
constraints
terminology constraints
annotations

according to openEHR template semantics and supported compiler capabilities.

OET serializer
            ↓
OET validator
            ↓
Compiler
            ↓
OPT

COMPOSITION
SECTION
ENTRY

for each exported artefact.

Imported into Designer
Imported by
Timestamp
Designer revision
Result
Notes

semantic diff
dependency diff

against the expected handoff.

node removed

requirements.title: Git-Native Artefact Preservation
requirements.requirement:
Git repositories should preserve native modelling artefacts rather than converting everything into an assistant-specific representation.

Recommended logical structure:

models/
├── archetypes/
│   ├── openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.example.v1.adl
│   └── ...
│
├── templates/
│   ├── example-template.oet
│   ├── example-template.t.json
│   └── ...
│
├── opts/
│   ├── example-template.opt
│   └── ...
│
├── web-templates/
│   └── ...
│
├── terminology/
│   └── ...
│
└── metadata/
    └── ...

The exact physical layout may remain configurable.

Preserve native artefact filenames where appropriate.

Do not rename files in ways that imply a different semantic artefact type.

For example:

*.t.json

must remain identifiable as Designer authoring JSON and must never automatically become:

*.opt

or:

*.oet
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

requirements.title: Do Not Pollute Native Model Files
requirements.requirement:
Assistant-specific governance metadata should not unnecessarily modify native openEHR or Designer files.

Prefer:

sidecar metadata
repository metadata
platform database
release manifests
provenance manifests

where appropriate.

For example:

models/
├── templates/
│   ├── neonatal-admission.oet
│   └── neonatal-admission.t.json
│
└── metadata/
    └── neonatal-admission.metadata.json

This reduces interoperability problems and allows external modelling tools to continue consuming their native formats.
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

requirements.title: Pull/Merge Request Workflow

Model change
      ↓
Working branch
      ↓
Validation
      ↓
OPT compilation where applicable
      ↓
Semantic diff
      ↓
Terminology validation
      ↓
QA
      ↓
Traceability
      ↓
Pull / Merge Request
      ↓
Human review
      ↓
Merge

The modelling assistant should be able to prepare the evidence needed for the review.

Where provider APIs are configured, support creation or inspection of pull/merge requests.

Do not assume GitHub/GitLab approval automatically constitutes clinical model approval.

Hosted Git review and clinical governance remain separate concepts unless an organisation explicitly configures policy mapping between them.

requirements.title: External Tool Concurrency
requirements.requirement:
Do not assume external modelling tools implement compatible locking or revision semantics.

Use repository revisions and optimistic concurrency.

Example:

Assistant reads revision 41
        ↓
Designer modifies model externally
        ↓
Repository becomes revision 42
        ↓
Assistant attempts write
expectedRevision=41
        ↓
REJECT

Return:

REVISION_CONFLICT

Do not silently overwrite the external modification.
requirements.note: Existing repository, native engine or document-profile behaviour supplies part of this requirement; full external-tool exchange acceptance is not established.

requirements.title: Source Revision Tracking

Git commit
External modelling-tool revision
Source artefact hash

where available.

{

  "gitCommit": "abc123...",
  "externalSource": {

Document mitigations.

requirements.title: Trust Boundary
requirements.requirement:
Treat every external modelling tool as a separate trust boundary.

Architecture:

External Modelling Tool
        │
        │ untrusted / externally controlled boundary
        ▼
ModellingToolAdapter
        │
        ▼
Security Validation
        │
        ├── Authentication verification
        ├── Transport security
        ├── Input-size limits
        ├── Format validation
        ├── XML/JSON security
        ├── Revision verification
        └── Provenance capture
        │
        ▼
Import Staging
        │
        ▼
openEHR Validation
        │
        ▼
Canonical Model Representation
        │
        ▼
Governed Model Repository

Never assume that an artefact is trustworthy merely because it originated from:

Archetype Designer
CKM
GitHub
GitLab
SharePoint
another modelling tool

Origin and validation are separate concepts.

requirements.title: External Endpoint Security
requirements.requirement:
Where an external modelling-tool adapter communicates over HTTP, enforce:

HTTPS
certificate verification
hostname verification
timeouts
response-size limits
redirect policy
allowed endpoint policy where appropriate

Do not provide a generic external URL parameter that allows arbitrary server-side requests.

Protect against SSRF.

requirements.title: External Endpoint Configuration
requirements.requirement:
External endpoints must be configured administratively.

Normal users and AI agents must not be able to supply arbitrary provider base URLs during ordinary modelling operations.

Use:

Configured Provider ID
        ↓
Validated Provider Configuration
        ↓
External Endpoint

rather than:

Agent supplied URL
        ↓
Server fetches arbitrary location

requirements.title: Transport Security
requirements.requirement:
Do not permit disabling TLS verification in production.

Development exceptions, if supported at all, must:

require explicit development mode
produce warnings
never become production defaults

requirements.title: External Response Validation
requirements.requirement:
Treat responses from external modelling tools as untrusted input.

Validate:

content type
size
encoding
expected schema
format version
identifiers
revision metadata

before importing them into governed state.

requirements.title: External Redirect Handling
requirements.requirement:
Do not automatically follow arbitrary redirects that could bypass endpoint restrictions.

If redirects are supported:

limit count
revalidate destination
retain HTTPS requirement
apply SSRF protections

requirements.title: External Credential Scope
requirements.requirement:
Use the least privilege available for external-tool credentials.

If the external system supports separate:

read
write
publish
administration

permissions, do not request publication/administration privileges merely to retrieve models.

requirements.title: Read-Only Integration Mode
requirements.requirement:
Support:

EXTERNAL_TOOL_MODE=read_only

or equivalent provider-level configuration.

This permits organisations to use Designer as a source while preventing the assistant from writing back.

requirements.title: Manual-Only Integration Mode
requirements.requirement:
Support a provider mode equivalent to:

MANUAL_EXCHANGE

In this mode:

no external credentials required
no external API calls
files exchanged manually
provenance still recorded
round-trip verification still available

This should be a first-class deployment option.

requirements.title: Automated Integration Mode
requirements.requirement:
Where verified external APIs exist, support:

AUTOMATED_EXCHANGE

only after:

provider configured
credentials verified
capabilities verified
security policy passed

Do not enable automation merely because a provider URL is configured.

requirements.title: Integration Modes
requirements.requirement:
Represent integration mode explicitly:

NONE
MANUAL_EXCHANGE
READ_ONLY_AUTOMATED
READ_WRITE_AUTOMATED

Where publication exists, treat it as an additional governed capability rather than assuming read-write includes publication.

requirements.title: Provider Capability Negotiation
requirements.requirement:
At connection/configuration time:

connect
 ↓
authenticate
 ↓
discover/verify capabilities
 ↓
store capability snapshot
 ↓
enable supported operations

Do not expose unsupported MCP/UI operations as though they work.

requirements.title: Capability Snapshot
requirements.requirement:
Store:

provider
provider version
account/deployment identifier where appropriate
verified capabilities
verification timestamp
adapter version

Allow revalidation.

requirements.title: Capability Change Detection
requirements.requirement:
If a provider’s capabilities change:

previous capability snapshot
        ↓
revalidate
        ↓
difference detected
        ↓
update capability state
        ↓
warn affected projects

Do not silently continue using an operation that is no longer available.

requirements.title: Format Capability Registry
requirements.requirement:
Track supported formats separately from provider operations.

Example:

Archetype Designer
DESIGNER_AUTHORING_JSON:
PRESERVE + INSPECT
OET:
IMPORT + EXPORT + VALIDATE
OPT:
IMPORT + INSPECT + VALIDATE
ADL:
IMPORT + VALIDATE

Actual statuses must come from implementation evidence.

requirements.title: Format Transformation Registry
requirements.requirement:
Represent supported transformations explicitly.

Example:

OET
  ↓
OPT

may be:

SUPPORTED

through the openEHR compiler.

But:

DESIGNER_AUTHORING_JSON
  ↓
OPT

must not automatically be marked supported unless an explicit verified conversion exists.

requirements.title: No Implicit Conversion
requirements.requirement:
Never infer:

File A looks similar to File B
        ↓
therefore formats are interchangeable

Every conversion must have:

defined source format
defined target format
implementation
tests
provenance
known limitations

requirements.title: Transformation Provenance
requirements.requirement:
For every conversion record:

source artefact
source revision
source hash
transformation
implementation
implementation version
target artefact
target hash
timestamp

requirements.title: Lossy Transformation Declaration
requirements.requirement:
If a transformation is known to lose information, declare:

LOSSY

and record:

lost fields
unsupported constructs
semantic implications

Do not describe a lossy conversion as round-trip safe.

requirements.title: Lossless Transformation Claim
requirements.requirement:
Only classify:

LOSSLESS

after deterministic round-trip evidence demonstrates preservation of all semantics covered by the source/target contract.

requirements.title: Canonical Representation Coverage
requirements.requirement:
Document which source semantics can be represented in the canonical internal model.

Maintain coverage for:

identifiers
RM types
nodes
paths
occurrences
cardinalities
constraints
slots
terminology
languages
annotations
dependencies
metadata

Unknown source-specific fields remain preserved in source metadata/original artefacts.

requirements.title: Canonical Model Versioning
requirements.requirement:
Version the canonical semantic representation.

Example:

canonicalModelVersion: 1

Schema changes require migration/versioning.

Do not silently reinterpret previously stored canonical models.

requirements.title: Canonical Model Schema
requirements.requirement:
Publish a machine-readable schema for the canonical representation.

Use it across:

semantic diff
visual modelling
external-tool adapters
dependency analysis
QA
model inspection

Avoid separate incompatible representations for each subsystem.

requirements.title: Canonical Model Round-Trip
requirements.requirement:
For supported standard artefacts test:

Source
 ↓
Parser
 ↓
Canonical Model
 ↓
Serializer
 ↓
Output
 ↓
Parser
 ↓
Canonical Model

Compare semantic equivalence.

requirements.title: Native Source Takes Precedence for Fidelity
requirements.requirement:
The canonical representation does not replace the immutable source artefact for fidelity purposes.

Always retain:

Immutable Original
Canonical Representation
Derived Artefacts

as distinct concepts.

requirements.title: External Modelling Tool Plugin Contract
requirements.requirement:
Formalise the adapter/plugin contract.

A provider implementation should declare:

provider ID
provider type
adapter version
supported modes
supported artefact formats
supported operations
configuration schema
authentication requirements

requirements.title: Adapter Isolation
requirements.requirement:
An adapter failure must not corrupt:

canonical models
repository history
releases
governance state
other providers

Use transaction boundaries.

requirements.title: Adapter Timeout
requirements.requirement:
External adapter operations must have bounded execution time.

Timeouts should be configurable within safe limits.

Do not allow an unavailable external provider to block worker/request execution indefinitely.

requirements.title: Adapter Retry Safety
requirements.requirement:
Retry only idempotent operations automatically unless the provider supplies an appropriate idempotency mechanism.

Do not automatically retry an uncertain write operation that might create duplicates or overwrite data.

requirements.title: External Write Idempotency
requirements.requirement:
Where provider capabilities allow, attach:

operation ID
expected external revision
idempotency key

to external writes.

requirements.title: External Write Verification
requirements.requirement:
After a successful external write:

write
 ↓
retrieve resulting revision
 ↓
verify
 ↓
record external revision

Do not rely only on an HTTP success status.

requirements.title: External Write Semantic Verification
requirements.requirement:
Where feasible:

Assistant handoff
      ↓
External write/import
      ↓
External retrieval/export
      ↓
Assistant import
      ↓
Semantic comparison

This provides stronger evidence of successful exchange.

requirements.title: External Write Failure
requirements.requirement:
If verification fails:

mark synchronisation uncertain
preserve operation evidence
do not claim success
require reconciliation

Use a state such as:

EXTERNAL_WRITE_VERIFICATION_FAILED

requirements.title: External Transaction Uncertainty
requirements.requirement:
Handle situations where:

request sent
 ↓
connection lost
 ↓
unknown whether external write occurred

Do not blindly repeat the write.

First inspect external state where possible.

requirements.title: External Revision Conflict
requirements.requirement:
If the provider reports revision conflict:

retrieve current external revision
 ↓
compare against baseline
 ↓
mark DIVERGED
 ↓
prepare reconciliation

Do not force overwrite by default.

requirements.title: Force Overwrite
requirements.requirement:
If an external provider technically supports forced overwrite, do not expose it to ordinary AI/service accounts.

Require:

explicit privileged permission
human action
audit
policy allowance

Prefer reconciliation.

requirements.title: External Deletion
requirements.requirement:
External model deletion must be treated as a high-impact operation.

Do not include deletion in normal model-write scopes.

Require explicit:

external_tools:delete

if implemented at all.

requirements.title: External Deletion Default
requirements.requirement:
Default:

external deletion disabled

unless there is a clear product requirement.

The modelling assistant generally does not need to delete external models to support governed modelling.

requirements.title: External Archive Preference
requirements.requirement: Where an external provider supports archival/deactivation, prefer it over destructive deletion for governed artefacts.

requirements.title: Model Exchange Event Model
requirements.requirement:
Represent exchange operations as domain events.

Examples:

ExternalArtifactImported
ExternalArtifactExported
ExternalRevisionDetected
ExternalDivergenceDetected
HandoffCreated
HandoffVerified
RoundTripVerified
RoundTripMismatchDetected

Use these events for audit/integration where appropriate.

requirements.title: Event Payload Safety
requirements.requirement:
Domain events must not contain:

passwords
API tokens
session cookies
secret URLs

Store safe references and metadata.

requirements.title: Model Exchange History
requirements.requirement:
Provide a timeline.

requirements.title: Timeline API
requirements.requirement:
Expose exchange history through the application layer.

Allow filtering by:

project
model
provider
operation
actor
date

requirements.title: Timeline UI
requirements.requirement:
Display modelling/exchange history in the reference workspace.

Distinguish:

model edit
validation
review
external exchange
release
deployment

visually or structurally.

requirements.title: Model Source Badge
requirements.requirement:
The UI should clearly display source.

Examples:

CKM
Organisation
Archetype Designer
Assistant Native

Do not make source provenance hidden deep in metadata.

requirements.title: Validation Badge
requirements.requirement:
Display actual validation level.

VALID

when only structural validation ran.

Prefer:

XML PASS
ADL PASS

Terminology PASS

as applicable.

Display:

based on evidence.

requirements.title: Synchronisation Badge

Display:

LOCAL AHEAD
EXTERNAL AHEAD
DIVERGED
UNKNOWN

for models associated with an external provider.

requirements.requirement:
Provide a dedicated provenance view.

origin
source artefact
source revision
hash
import event
derivations

handoffs
external revisions
release

requirements.title: Dependency Inspector
requirements.requirement:
For externally sourced models show:

transitive dependencies

resolution status

requirements.title: Missing Dependency Workflow
requirements.requirement:
If an imported model references unavailable dependencies:

detect
 ↓
identify missing dependency
 ↓
search configured repositories/CKMs
 ↓
present candidates
 ↓
resolve according to policy

Do not silently ignore missing dependencies.

requirements.title: Dependency Auto-Resolution
requirements.requirement:
Automatic resolution may occur only when:

identifier uniquely matches
version requirements match
source policy allows it
no conflict exists

Record resolution evidence.

requirements.title: Ambiguous Dependency
requirements.requirement:
If multiple valid candidates exist:

do not arbitrarily choose

Return:

AMBIGUOUS_DEPENDENCY

with candidates.

An agent may recommend a candidate with evidence, but selection must remain explicit when semantics could differ.

requirements.title: Dependency Pinning
requirements.requirement:
Once resolved for a governed build, pin:

identifier
version
source
hash

in the dependency lock/manifest.

requirements.title: Dependency Refresh
requirements.requirement:
Provide explicit:

check for updates

rather than silently replacing pinned dependencies.

requirements.title: Dependency Update Preview
requirements.requirement:
Before updating:

current dependency
      ↓
candidate newer dependency
      ↓
semantic diff
      ↓
impact analysis
      ↓
update preview

requirements.title: Dependency Update Governance
requirements.requirement:
Updating a dependency creates a new working revision.

It must pass:

validation
compilation
QA
review

according to policy before release.

requirements.title: Designer Dependency Bundle
requirements.requirement:
If Designer import requires supporting archetypes, include them where legally and technically appropriate.

The handoff should identify:

primary import artefact
required dependencies
dependency versions
dependency source

requirements.title: Dependency Redistribution Rules
requirements.requirement:
Do not automatically bundle external dependencies if licensing prohibits redistribution.

Where necessary provide:

dependency identifier
source location
version
hash

instead.

requirements.title: External Tool Import Ordering
requirements.requirement:
Where multiple artefacts must be imported in a particular order, generate explicit instructions.

requirements.title: Provider-Specific Handoff Instructions
requirements.requirement:

Example:

ArchetypeDesignerAdapter
        ↓
Handoff Instructions

requirements.title: Provider Documentation Version
requirements.requirement:
Record which integration-guide version generated the handoff instructions.

This helps diagnose changes in external tool behaviour.

requirements.title: Designer UX Verification
requirements.requirement:
Where a live Designer environment is available, verify documentation against the actual UI.

Do not publish click-by-click instructions based solely on assumptions.

Mark UI instructions with the tested version/date.

requirements.title: UI Documentation Drift
requirements.requirement:
When Designer UI changes but the file/API interoperability remains valid:

update workflow documentation

without incorrectly downgrading protocol-level compatibility.

Separate:

UI workflow compatibility

from:

artefact semantic compatibility

requirements.title: External Tool Documentation Tests
requirements.requirement:
Where practical, test example files referenced by documentation.

Do not allow docs to point to nonexistent fixtures or obsolete commands.

requirements.requirement: Provide a concise Designer quick start:

requirements.title: Agent Revision Safety
requirements.requirement:
Every agent write must use current revision information.

Agents should:

read
 ↓
receive revision
 ↓
prepare change
 ↓
write expectedRevision

If stale:

retrieve latest
 ↓
semantic diff
 ↓
reconcile

requirements.title: Agent Must Not Guess Format
requirements.requirement:
Before manipulating an uploaded file, the agent should invoke deterministic artefact identification.

Do not infer:

".json means Designer"

or:

".xml means OPT"

without parsing/detection.

requirements.title: Agent Must Not Guess Compatibility
requirements.requirement:
If compatibility status is:

UNVERIFIED

the agent must describe it as unverified.

It may initiate available verification workflows.

requirements.title: Agent Must Not Invent External Capabilities
requirements.requirement:
If provider capability data says:

automatedExport=false

the agent must not claim that automated export is available.

Likewise, if:

automatedImport=false
automatedPublish=false
apiAccess=false

the agent must use the supported manual workflow.

Agent behaviour must derive from:

provider capability registry
verified compatibility evidence
current configuration

rather than assumptions.

requirements.title: Agent Must Respect Artefact Semantics
requirements.requirement:
An agent must never treat:

Designer .t.json

as:

OET
OPT
Web Template

unless an explicit verified transformation exists.

The agent should use deterministic artefact-type information supplied by the platform.

requirements.title: Agent Must Preserve Source Artefacts
requirements.requirement:
When modifying a model imported from an external tool:

Immutable source
      ↓
Working revision

The agent modifies the working representation/revision.

It must not overwrite the immutable imported baseline.

requirements.title: Agent Must Use Deterministic Validation
requirements.requirement:
After a model modification:

Agent change
      ↓
openEHR validation
      ↓
semantic diff
      ↓
QA

Do not rely on:

"The generated XML looks correct."

requirements.title: Agent Must Compile Rather Than Assume
requirements.requirement:
For template changes:

OET
 ↓
validate
 ↓
resolve dependencies
 ↓
compile
 ↓
validate OPT

A successful OET serialization is not proof of successful template compilation.
requirements.note: Implemented native ADL 2 and bounded legacy OET compilation profiles with exact-revision build evidence. Full OET/AOM semantics, external tool interchange and the complete exchange governance contract remain open.

requirements.title: Agent Must Inspect Compilation Errors
requirements.requirement:
If compilation fails:

inspect structured compiler errors
      ↓
identify source problem
      ↓
correct model
      ↓
validate
      ↓
compile again

Do not suppress compiler failures.
requirements.note: Implemented native ADL 2 and bounded legacy OET compilation profiles with exact-revision build evidence. Full OET/AOM semantics, external tool interchange and the complete exchange governance contract remain open.

requirements.title: Agent Must Respect Governance
requirements.requirement:
An agent may:

create draft
modify draft
validate
compile
run QA
prepare diff
prepare review
request review
generate handoff

An ordinary agent must not:

approve model
publish model
force external overwrite
publish externally
bypass release gates

unless an explicitly designed governance mechanism permits a specific non-clinical operation.

Human clinical approval remains protected.

requirements.title: Agent Must Expose Uncertainty
requirements.requirement:
If the system cannot determine whether information will survive a Designer round trip:

report uncertainty

Do not silently assume preservation.

Example:

requirements.title: Agent Must Use Provenance
requirements.requirement:
When recommending or modifying a model, provide source context where relevant:

source
version
revision
governance status
validation status

This prevents an agent from treating unrelated artefacts as equivalent.

requirements.title: Agent Must Prefer Governed Models
requirements.requirement:
When equivalent models exist, use configured organisational source-selection policy.

Do not automatically prefer:

newest
international
Designer
CKM
AI-generated

without considering policy.

requirements.title: Agent Must Search Before Creating
requirements.requirement:
Before creating a new archetype or major template component:

search project repository
      ↓
search organisation repository
      ↓
search configured CKMs
      ↓
inspect candidates
      ↓
reuse where appropriate
      ↓
create only when justified

This is particularly important for avoiding unnecessary duplicate clinical models.

requirements.title: Agent Must Explain New Model Creation

If a new archetype is required, record why existing models were unsuitable.

Example:

...
Candidates evaluated:
...
Reason not reused:
...
Decision:
Create organisation-specific archetype.

Store this as modelling decision evidence.

requirements.title: Agent Must Not Modify Upstream Source Directly
requirements.requirement:
When an upstream CKM/Designer artefact needs local changes:

import baseline
      ↓
create governed local revision/fork

Do not rewrite the upstream provenance.

requirements.title: Agent Must Preserve Licensing
requirements.requirement:
When importing or packaging external models, preserve known:

licence
copyright
attribution
source

Do not strip attribution to make an artefact appear organisation-authored.

requirements.title: Agent Handoff Behaviour
requirements.requirement:
When asked:

"Give this back to Designer"

the agent should:

identify target provider
      ↓
inspect provider capabilities
      ↓
validate current revision
      ↓
run required QA
      ↓
check governance policy
      ↓
generate handoff
      ↓
identify exact import artefact
      ↓
provide checksum

If automated export is verified and authorised, the appropriate adapter may perform it.

Otherwise produce the manual handoff.

requirements.title: Agent External Import Behaviour
requirements.requirement:
When asked:

"Import this Designer model"

      ↓
security checks
      ↓
preserve immutable original
      ↓
extract provenance
      ↓
parse
      ↓
validate
      ↓
resolve dependencies
      ↓
preview changes
      ↓
import governed revision

Do not immediately overwrite an existing project model.

requirements.title: Agent Conflict Behaviour

If:

REVISION_CONFLICT

or:

DIVERGED

occurs, the agent should:

retrieve current revisions
      ↓
run semantic comparison
      ↓
identify conflicting changes
      ↓
prepare reconciliation

Do not retry the same stale write.

requirements.title: Agent Round-Trip Verification
requirements.requirement:
When asked whether a handoff survived Designer import:

      ↓
identify
      ↓
validate
      ↓
semantic comparison
      ↓
report preservation/loss
      ↓
store verification evidence

requirements.title: Agent Compatibility Language

Use precise language.

Test:

invalid endpoint
HTTP instead of HTTPS in production
SSRF targets
redirect to prohibited destination
invalid certificate
credential redaction

requirements.title: Handoff Tests
requirements.requirement:
Verify handoff contains:

manifest
README
import target
checksums
provenance
validation evidence
governance state

requirements.title: Handoff Integrity Tests
requirements.requirement:
Modify a file after handoff generation.

Verification must fail because checksum no longer matches.

requirements.title: Round-Trip Tests
requirements.requirement:
For each claimed compatibility level, maintain tests demonstrating the claim.

Do not assign compatibility status manually without corresponding evidence.

requirements.title: Divergence Tests
requirements.requirement:
Simulate:

baseline
local change
external change

Verify:

LOCAL_AHEAD
EXTERNAL_AHEAD
DIVERGED

classification.

requirements.title: Three-Way Reconciliation Tests
requirements.requirement:
Test:

non-conflicting changes
same change on both sides
conflicting cardinality
conflicting terminology
conflicting node deletion/modification

requirements.title: Provider Capability Tests
requirements.requirement:
Mock providers with different capabilities.

Verify the platform exposes only supported operations.

requirements.title: Manual-Only Provider Test
requirements.requirement:
Test:

MANUAL_EXCHANGE

with no credentials or network.

Full manual import/handoff/round-trip workflow must function.

requirements.title: Read-Only Provider Test
requirements.requirement:
Verify:

retrieve/import works
external write rejected

requirements.title: Automated Provider Contract Tests
requirements.requirement:
Where provider API automation exists, test through provider mocks/contract fixtures.

Live credentials must not be required for default CI.

requirements.title: Live Acceptance Tests
requirements.requirement:
Keep live Designer tests:

opt-in
credential-driven
isolated from default CI

Record results as compatibility evidence.

requirements.title: External Acceptance Required
requirements.requirement:
If live Designer access is unavailable, only the live verification component should remain:

EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED

The adapter architecture, parsing, validation, handoff, security, tests and documentation must still be completed.

README.md

requirements.title: README Integration Summary
requirements.requirement:
The README should explain the integration succinctly.

It should state that the platform can:

preserve native external modelling artefacts
record provenance
validate openEHR artefacts
compile templates into OPTs
perform semantic comparison
manage revisions
generate governed handoffs
verify round trips

according to implemented/tested capabilities.

requirements.title: Remove Outdated README Limitations
requirements.requirement:
Remove statements that are no longer true after implementation.

Examples:

cannot compile OPT
only structural validation
only COMPOSITION + direct ENTRY OET generation

but only after the replacement capabilities actually pass tests.

requirements.title: Preserve Remaining Limitations
requirements.requirement:
If a limitation remains true, keep it.

Examples might include:

specific Designer API unavailable
specific Designer format not safely editable
specific hosted automation unverified

Do not hide real limitations merely to make the product appear complete.

requirements.title: Capability Matrix Update
requirements.requirement:
Update external-modelling-tool capabilities with evidence-based statuses:

IMPLEMENTED
VERIFIED
EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED
NOT_SUPPORTED

Avoid vague:

PARTIAL

when a more precise state is possible.

docs/IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md

covering:

artefact preservation
canonical model
Designer integration
OET engineering
OPT compilation
semantic diff
provenance
round-trip verification
Git workflow
security
test evidence
external acceptance requirements

immutable source preservation
canonical semantic model
Designer authoring JSON treatment
external modelling-tool adapter abstraction
semantic hashing
round-trip compatibility levels
manual-first interoperability

requirements.title: Generated Tool Documentation

artefact retrieval

handoff

provider capabilities
synchronisation state

requirements.title: Migration Documentation
requirements.requirement:
Document migration from the original file-only workflow.

Explain:

old behaviour
new artefact model
new provenance
new revisions
new validation
new compilation
new handoff

Existing repositories must remain usable or have an explicit migration path.

requirements.title: Backwards Compatibility
requirements.requirement:
Preserve existing MCP tool names where reasonable.

If replacing an old tool:

deprecate
document replacement
maintain compatibility wrapper where practical
remove according to version policy

requirements.title: Existing Artefact Migration
requirements.requirement:
For artefacts already stored before provenance enhancements:

identify
      ↓
preserve exact existing content
      ↓
calculate source hash
      ↓
detect/classify format
      ↓
extract deterministically available metadata
      ↓
create migration provenance
      ↓
retain original repository revision
      ↓
build canonical representation where supported
      ↓
validate where supported
      ↓
index for search

Do not invent unknown source information.

If the original external source is unknown, record:

source:
UNKNOWN

Do not infer:

Archetype Designer

merely from filename or repository location unless deterministic evidence supports that conclusion.

Preserve historical timestamps and revision information where available.

requirements.title: Migration Provenance
Migration Idempotency
requirements.requirement:
Migration must be safe to rerun.

Running the migration twice must not:

duplicate artefacts
duplicate provenance
change hashes
create duplicate revisions
rewrite immutable originals

Use migration/version markers.

requirements.title: Migration Dry Run
requirements.requirement:
Provide:

DRY_RUN

support.

Before migration, report:

artefacts discovered
detected types
unknown types
potential conflicts
expected repository changes
validation availability

without modifying stored state.

requirements.title: Migration Backup Requirement
requirements.requirement:
Before modifying persistent repository metadata, ensure an appropriate backup or rollback strategy exists.

For filesystem/Git-backed repositories, preserve the original repository state.

For database metadata, use versioned migrations and transactional safety.

requirements.title: Migration Failure
requirements.requirement:
If migration fails for one artefact:

preserve original
record migration failure
continue or rollback according to configured migration mode

Never leave the source artefact partially rewritten.

requirements.title: Migration Report
requirements.requirement:
Generate:

docs/migrations/<migration-id>-report.md

or equivalent machine/human-readable evidence containing:

artefacts processed
artefacts migrated
artefacts skipped
unknown formats
validation failures
conflicts
errors

Do not include secrets.

requirements.title: Phase — Final Repository-Wide Audit
requirements.requirement:
After implementing the complete external-modelling-tool subsystem, perform a new repository-wide audit.

Search for:

TODO
FIXME
stub
placeholder
not implemented
partial
reserved
future
temporary
mock only
unsupported
Designer limitation
cannot compile
structural only
direct ENTRY

Review every occurrence in context.

Do not automatically remove legitimate statements describing actual remaining limitations.

requirements.title: Implementation-vs-Documentation Audit
requirements.requirement:
Compare:

code
tests
CAPABILITIES.md
README
architecture documentation
Designer documentation
MCP documentation
OpenAPI
CLI documentation

They must describe the same product.

requirements.title: Old Limitation Audit
requirements.requirement:
Specifically search documentation for historical statements such as:

cannot compile OPT
only structural XML validation
draft OET supports only direct ENTRY archetypes
Designer .t.json can be treated as OPT
Designer integration is automatically lossless
Designer automated export is available

Correct them according to actual implementation evidence.

requirements.title: No False Completion
requirements.requirement:
Do not mark a capability implemented merely because:

interface exists
configuration exists
stub exists
mock test passes
documentation describes it

An implemented capability requires executable behaviour and appropriate tests.

requirements.title: No Permanent Partial State Without Reason
requirements.requirement:
For every remaining:

PARTIAL

capability, determine whether the missing work is technically implementable.

If yes:

implement it

If genuinely blocked by external access:

EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED

If the external tool does not support the capability:

NOT_SUPPORTED

Use precise classifications.

requirements.requirement:
Run deterministic validation against representative:

ADL
OET
OPT
Designer-exported artefacts where applicable

Use both:

known valid
known invalid

fixtures.

Verify invalid artefacts are actually rejected.

Run:

complex OET
      ↓
dependency resolution
      ↓
openEHR validation
      ↓
OPT compilation
      ↓
OPT validation

Verify the resulting OPT can be inspected deterministically.

The reference template must exercise more than:

COMPOSITION + direct ENTRY

SECTION

nested CLUSTER
occurrences
cardinality
terminology constraints
annotations
slots where appropriate

requirements.title: Final Semantic Diff Gate
requirements.requirement:
Create controlled model changes and verify detection of:

node added
node removed
identifier changed
RM type changed
datatype changed
occurrence changed
cardinality changed
constraint changed
terminology changed

annotation changed
dependency changed

requirements.title: Final Serialization-Difference Gate
requirements.requirement: Verify semantically equivalent artefacts with harmless serialization differences do not generate false clinical-model changes.

requirements.title: Final Provenance Gate
requirements.requirement:
Select a model and prove the system can answer:

Where did this model come from?
What exact source file was imported?
What was its source revision?
What was its original hash?
Who imported it?
Which revisions followed?
Which artefacts were derived from it?
Which compiler produced the OPT?
Which release contains it?
Was it handed back to Designer?
Was the round trip verified?

These answers must come from persisted provenance, not agent memory.

requirements.title: Final Revision-Safety Gate
requirements.requirement:
Simulate concurrent editing.

Workflow:

Client A reads revision 50
Client B reads revision 50
Client A writes expectedRevision=50
        ↓
revision 51
Client B writes expectedRevision=50
        ↓
REJECT

Verify Client A’s work is not overwritten.

requirements.title: Final Reconciliation Gate
requirements.requirement:
Simulate:

baseline
assistant change
external Designer change

Run three-way semantic reconciliation.

Verify detection of:

non-conflicting changes
conflicting constraints
conflicting terminology
delete-vs-modify conflicts

requirements.title: Final Source-Preservation Gate
requirements.requirement:
For each supported source format:

import original
      ↓
store
      ↓
retrieve immutable source
      ↓
byte comparison

The bytes must match exactly unless the source-storage contract explicitly defines another preservation mechanism.

requirements.title: Final Designer JSON Gate
requirements.requirement:
Verify .t.json is always classified as its own artefact type.

Test that no code path silently:

renames it to OPT
renames it to OET
treats it as Web Template
claims standards-level equivalence

requirements.title: Final Handoff Gate
requirements.requirement:
Generate a complete handoff.

Verify it contains:

README
manifest
import target
original source where appropriate
dependencies
checksums
validation evidence
governance state
compatibility state
known limitations

requirements.requirement:
Modify the handoff import target after generation.

Run verification.

Expected:

CHECKSUM_MISMATCH

requirements.title: Final Round-Trip Gate
requirements.requirement:
Where live Designer access is available:

Assistant handoff
      ↓
Designer import
      ↓
Designer re-export
      ↓
Assistant import
      ↓
semantic comparison

Persist the evidence.

EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED

NO DESIGNER API
NO DESIGNER CREDENTIALS

using manually exchanged files.

import
preservation
validation
governance
handoff
round-trip comparison

model repository works

when required dependencies are locally available.

requirements.title: Final Provider Failure Gate

Verify:

provider operation fails clearly
core modelling remains healthy
existing models remain accessible
no governed data corruption occurs

XML entity expansion
deep JSON
oversized input
path traversal
archive traversal
SSRF
unsafe redirects
invalid TLS
credential leakage

requirements.title: Final Permission Gate
requirements.requirement:
Test:

Viewer cannot import
Viewer cannot export restricted models
Modeller can perform permitted edits
Reviewer can review
ordinary agent cannot approve
ordinary agent cannot publish externally
administrator can configure provider
revoked service account cannot authenticate

requirements.title: Final Audit Gate
requirements.requirement:
Verify all sensitive external operations create appropriate audit events.

Test:

import
export
handoff
external write
round-trip verification
provider configuration
credential rotation
external publication where supported

requirements.title: Final Secret-Redaction Gate
requirements.requirement:
Inject test secrets and verify they do not appear in:

logs
MCP errors
REST errors
audit details
Git
handoff bundles
generated documentation

requirements.requirement:
Backup a project containing:

Designer source artefact
working revision
compiled OPT
provenance
handoff
round-trip evidence

Restore into a clean environment.

Verify relationships remain intact.

requirements.title: Final Portability Gate
requirements.requirement:
Export the project/package and import it into another clean Modelling Assistant instance.

Verify preservation of:

source artefacts
hashes
provenance
revisions
dependencies
validation evidence
compatibility evidence
handoff evidence

subject to package policy.

requirements.title: Final Git Gate
requirements.requirement:
For a Git-backed repository, exercise:

clone
read
branch
write
commit
push
refresh
revision conflict
semantic diff

Verify native modelling artefacts remain usable outside the assistant.

requirements.title: Final GitHub/GitLab Gate
requirements.requirement:
Where provider APIs are configured, test provider-specific functionality separately from generic Git.

Examples:

pull/merge request creation
review metadata
branch metadata
hosted links

Generic Git functionality must not depend on these APIs.

requirements.title: Final Documentation Gate
requirements.requirement:
Read the Designer integration documentation as a new clinical modeller.

Verify a user can understand:

what to export
how to import
what .t.json means
what OET means
what OPT means
how validation works
how compilation works
how handoff works
how to return to Designer
how round-trip verification works

without reading source code.

requirements.title: Final Agent Documentation Gate
requirements.requirement:
Verify an AI agent receives enough structured tool documentation to correctly:

identify artefacts
preserve provenance
validate
compile
compare
save revisions
handle conflicts
prepare handoffs

without relying on hidden repository knowledge.

requirements.title: Final Compatibility Claim Audit
requirements.requirement:
Search the entire repository for claims containing concepts such as:

compatible
lossless
supported
verified
automated
round trip
Designer integration

Every substantive compatibility claim must be supported by evidence.

openEHR modelling artefacts
openEHR validation
openEHR compilation
model provenance
model repositories
model governance
external modelling-tool exchange

Do not expand it into unrelated healthcare integration functionality.

requirements.title: External Modelling Tool Role
requirements.requirement:
The architectural role of external modelling tools is:

SPECIALISED AUTHORING ENVIRONMENT

not:

SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR ALL GOVERNANCE

The governed platform repository maintains:

provenance
revision history
validation
compilation evidence
QA
review
release

requirements.title: Source of Truth
requirements.requirement:
Define sources of truth explicitly.

For example:

Exact imported bytes
→ Immutable Source Artefact
Current governed working model
→ Model Repository Revision
Compiled runtime model
→ Generated OPT Build Artefact
Approved model set
→ Release
External authoring state
→ External Tool Revision

Do not collapse these concepts.

requirements.title: Designer Is Not the Only Source of Truth
requirements.requirement:
Do not make:

Archetype Designer

the mandatory master repository.

Organisations may choose:

Git
filesystem
SharePoint
other governed repository

as the authoritative model repository while using Designer as an authoring tool.

requirements.title: Git as Shared Authoring Backbone
requirements.requirement:
Where Git is selected:

Designer / External Tool
          ↕
         Git
          ↕
Modelling Assistant

can form the shared model workflow.

However, verify actual Designer Git capabilities before claiming direct synchronization.

Manual export/import through Git remains acceptable.

requirements.title: SharePoint as Organisational Repository
requirements.requirement:
Where SharePoint is selected:

Designer
   ↓
export
   ↓
SharePoint
   ↕
Modelling Assistant

may be supported through the repository adapter.

Do not require SharePoint for other deployments.

requirements.title: Filesystem Deployment
requirements.requirement:
For small/offline installations:

Designer
   ↓
export
   ↓
Filesystem Model Repository
   ↕
Modelling Assistant

must remain fully supported.

requirements.title: Repository Independence
requirements.requirement:
The same external modelling workflow should operate against:

filesystem
Git
GitHub/GitLab-backed Git
SharePoint

through the repository abstraction.

Do not implement separate modelling semantics for each storage provider.
